title: Delay Grace Minutes for Wayfare Pass Members on Wayfare Rides
content:
**Member benefit schedule.** The delay grace minutes on a detoured trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** follow the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** membership in force at the request — its plan and its status.

| Membership in force at the request | Status | Delay grace minutes |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual or Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | trial, active or pending cancellation | 0 minutes (Plus delay grace) |
| any other Wayfare Pass plan | trial, active or pending cancellation | 5 minutes (member delay grace) |
| any other rider | — | not changed by membership |

A Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, Plus Annual or All Access Annual membership in trial, active or pending cancellation status takes the Plus delay grace of 0 minutes; any other membership in one of those statuses takes the member delay grace of 5 minutes; for any other rider the delay grace minutes are not changed by membership.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical memberships)

- An active Wayfare Pass Monthly membership: 5 minutes.
- A Wayfare Pass All Access Annual membership in pending cancellation status: 0 minutes.
- A Wayfare Pass Plus Annual membership that is paused, or past due: not changed — the plan alone does not decide it.
- No membership in force at the request: not changed.
